Name: Void's Furniture Galore
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Well, well, well....what do we have here? This mod brings you some nice selection of furniture by yours truly in a bunch of wood colors(classic, dark, ourple, white, mahogany and bog). There is a bit of everything because why not? Side tables, tea tables, bookshelves, rugs....heck, there's even a bunch of wallpapers and floors because half-way I felt like doing those![/center]
[center][/center]
[center]There way the furniture can be acquired is via a catalogue that you can buy at Robin's. The wallpapers and floors are simply part of the usual wallpapers and floors catalogue from vanilla.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center] - Install the latest version of SMAPI, MMAP and Content Patcher. [/center]
[center]- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/center]
[center]- Run the game using SMAPI.[/center]
